Welcome to Cá Chép Hotel: Your Serene Retreat in Phu Quoc Island

Nestled on the picturesque Phu Quoc Island, Cá Chép Hotel offers a tranquil escape for travelers seeking both comfort and convenience. Opened in 2022 and recently renovated in 2024, this charming 3-star hotel features a total of 9 well-appointed rooms, ensuring an intimate and personalized experience for every guest. Located just 27 kilometers from the bustling city center and a mere 35 minutes from the airport, Cá Chép Hotel is perfectly situated for those looking to explore the island's stunning beaches and vibrant local culture.

At Cá Chép Hotel, we prioritize your comfort and convenience. Guests can check in from 2:00 PM and enjoy a leisurely check-out until 12:00 PM, allowing you to soak in the serene surroundings a little longer. Families are warmly welcomed, as the hotel offers a generous child policy that allows children aged 0 to 11 to stay free of charge. Whether you're traveling with family or on a romantic getaway, Cá Chép Hotel is your ideal base for discovering the beauty of Phu Quoc Island.

Unwind in Style: Entertainment Facilities at Cá Chép Hotel

At Cá Chép Hotel, entertainment takes on a whole new meaning with its inviting shared lounge and TV area, designed to cater to both relaxation and socialization. This cozy space serves as the heart of the hotel, offering guests a welcoming environment to unwind after a day of exploring the stunning landscapes of Phu Quoc Island. With comfortable seating and a warm ambiance, it’s the perfect spot to connect with fellow travelers, share stories, or simply kick back with a good book.

The shared lounge is equipped with a large flat-screen TV, providing an array of entertainment options for guests. Whether you want to catch up on your favorite shows, enjoy a movie night with friends, or cheer for your team during a live sports event, this area ensures that you won’t miss out on any of the action. The blend of comfort and entertainment makes the shared lounge at Cá Chép Hotel an ideal retreat, allowing you to relax in style while creating lasting memories with fellow guests.

Unleash Your Adventurous Spirit at Cá Chép Hotel's Sports Facilities

At Cá Chép Hotel, located on the stunning Phu Quoc Island, guests are invited to dive into a world of exhilarating sports activities that promise to make your stay unforgettable. The hotel offers a variety of water sports that cater to both thrill-seekers and those looking to relax. Experience the thrill of fishing in the crystal-clear waters, where you can cast your line and reel in the catch of the day. For those eager to explore the vibrant underwater world, snorkeling and diving excursions are readily available, allowing you to discover the breathtaking coral reefs and marine life that thrive in the surrounding seas.

If you prefer a more leisurely pace, why not take a canoe out for a serene paddle along the coastline? Glide over the gentle waves and soak in the picturesque views of the island's lush landscapes. For families and fun-seekers, the on-site water park offers a splash-tastic experience, complete with slides and pools that guarantee hours of enjoyment for all ages. With the beach just a stone's throw away, you can seamlessly transition from thrilling water sports to sunbathing on the sandy shores. At Cá Chép Hotel, every moment is an opportunity for adventure and relaxation, making it the perfect destination for sports enthusiasts and beach lovers alike.

Convenience Facilities at Cá Chép Hotel

At Cá Chép Hotel, convenience is a top priority, ensuring that your stay on the beautiful Phu Quoc Island is as seamless as possible. Guests can take advantage of the complimentary Wi-Fi available in all rooms, allowing you to stay connected and share your tropical adventures in real-time. Additionally, the hotel offers free Wi-Fi in public areas, making it easy to catch up on emails or plan your next excursion while enjoying the inviting atmosphere of the hotel.

For those traveling with luggage, Cá Chép Hotel provides a secure luggage storage service, allowing you to explore the island without the burden of your bags. The daily housekeeping service ensures that your room remains a comfortable sanctuary throughout your stay. Moreover, the designated smoking area caters to guests who appreciate the freedom to smoke without disturbing others. With these thoughtful amenities, Cá Chép Hotel is committed to enhancing your experience and providing all the conveniences you need for a relaxing getaway.

Seamless Transportation at Cá Chép Hotel

At Cá Chép Hotel, we understand that seamless transportation is key to enhancing your travel experience on the picturesque Phu Quoc Island. Our dedicated car park provides a secure and convenient space for guests who choose to drive, ensuring peace of mind while you explore the island's stunning landscapes. Whether you're embarking on a day of adventure or returning from a leisurely outing, our car park is designed to accommodate your needs effortlessly.

For those who prefer not to drive, Cá Chép Hotel offers a reliable taxi service that allows you to navigate the island with ease. Our knowledgeable staff is always on hand to assist you in hailing a taxi, ensuring you reach your desired destination quickly and comfortably. Additionally, we provide a comprehensive ticket service for local tours and attractions, making it simple for you to plan your itinerary and discover the best that Phu Quoc has to offer. With these transport facilities, Cá Chép Hotel is committed to making your stay both enjoyable and hassle-free.

Comfort and Convenience at Cá Chép Hotel

At Cá Chép Hotel, each room is designed to provide a sanctuary of comfort and relaxation, ensuring that your stay on Phu Quoc Island is nothing short of spectacular. Guests can enjoy the refreshing coolness of air conditioning, allowing for a perfect retreat from the tropical heat. Each room is equipped with modern amenities, including a hair dryer for your convenience, and a satellite/cable TV to keep you entertained during your downtime.

Step out onto your private balcony or terrace, where you can savor the stunning views of the surrounding landscape while sipping on complimentary instant coffee or tea. The thoughtfully provided complimentary bottled water ensures you stay hydrated as you explore the island. With plush linens, blackout curtains for a restful sleep, and essential toiletries provided, every detail has been considered to make your stay as comfortable as possible. Experience tranquility and modern luxury at Cá Chép Hotel, where every room is a gateway to relaxation and rejuvenation.

Culinary Delights at Cá Chép Hotel

At Cá Chép Hotel, dining is not just a necessity; it’s an experience that tantalizes your taste buds and embraces the vibrant flavors of Vietnam. The hotel offers a range of dining facilities designed to cater to every palate, ensuring that every meal is memorable. Guests can indulge in a delightful selection of local and international dishes, expertly prepared by skilled chefs who take pride in using fresh, locally sourced ingredients. Whether you’re craving traditional Vietnamese cuisine or international favorites, the dining options at Cá Chép Hotel promise to satisfy even the most discerning food lovers.

In addition to the exquisite dining experiences, Cá Chép Hotel provides convenient grocery delivery services, allowing guests to enjoy the comforts of home while on vacation. With the option to have fresh ingredients delivered to your room, you can easily whip up your own culinary creations or simply enjoy a cozy meal in the privacy of your accommodation. This unique feature enhances the overall experience, making it easy for guests to savor the flavors of Phu Quoc Island at their own pace.

Comfortable and Diverse Room Options at Cá Chép Hotel

Cá Chép Hotel offers a variety of thoughtfully designed rooms to suit every traveler’s needs. Guests can choose from the spacious Superior Balcony 1 King, featuring a 30-square-meter layout with a luxurious King Bed, or opt for the Superior Courtyard View Twin Room, also 30 square meters, equipped with two Single Beds perfect for friends or family. For those seeking stunning views, the Deluxe Sea View Queen Room with Balcony and the Deluxe Partial Sea View Room with Balcony both provide 35 square meters of comfort along with scenic vistas that enhance your stay.

Traveling with family or a group? The Deluxe Family Bunk offers an expansive 55 square meters space, accommodating a Queen Bed or two Bunk Beds to ensure everyone has room to relax. Booking your preferred room type through Agoda guarantees you the best prices available, along with a seamless, hassle-free booking experience that lets you focus on enjoying your trip to Phu Quoc Island.

Discover the Charm of An Thoi, Phu Quoc Island

Nestled in the southern part of Phu Quoc Island, An Thoi is a captivating coastal town that offers a delightful blend of natural beauty and cultural richness. Known for its stunning beaches and crystal-clear waters, An Thoi is an ideal destination for those seeking a tranquil escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. The area is dotted with picturesque fishing villages, where you can witness local fishermen bringing in their daily catch, providing a glimpse into the traditional Vietnamese way of life. The warm hospitality of the locals adds to the charm, making visitors feel right at home in this serene setting.

An Thoi serves as a gateway to some of the most breathtaking islands in the region, including the famous An Thoi Archipelago. Just a short boat ride away, these islands boast pristine beaches, vibrant coral reefs, and lush greenery, perfect for snorkeling, diving, or simply soaking up the sun. Whether you choose to explore the uninhabited islets or relax on the soft sandy shores, An Thoi promises unforgettable experiences for nature lovers and adventure seekers alike. As the sun sets, the sky transforms into a canvas of vibrant hues, providing a perfect backdrop for a romantic evening or a peaceful stroll along the beach, making An Thoi a must-visit destination on your Phu Quoc journey.

Traveling from Phu Quoc International Airport to Cá Chép Hotel

Reaching Cá Chép Hotel from Phu Quoc International Airport is a seamless experience that sets the tone for your relaxing escape on this beautiful island. Upon arriving at the airport, travelers will find a variety of transportation options readily available. The most convenient way to reach the hotel is by taxi or pre-arranged shuttle service, which takes about 30 to 40 minutes depending on traffic conditions. As you traverse the scenic coastal roads, you'll be treated to stunning views of the turquoise waters and lush greenery that Phu Quoc is renowned for, making the journey itself a delightful part of your adventure.

If you prefer a more local experience, consider renting a scooter or motorbike, which allows you to explore the island at your own pace. The ride to Cá Chép Hotel will take you through charming villages and along picturesque beaches, providing an immersive introduction to the island's vibrant culture. Whichever mode of transportation you choose, the warm hospitality of the locals and the breathtaking landscapes will surely enhance your anticipation of arriving at Cá Chép Hotel, where relaxation and comfort await.

Explore the Rich History and Scenic Beauty Near Cá Chép Hotel

Cá Chép Hotel is ideally situated for guests eager to explore some of Phu Quoc Island's most significant landmarks. Just a short distance away, the Phu Quoc Prison stands as a poignant reminder of Vietnam's tumultuous history. This historical site offers visitors a glimpse into the past, showcasing the resilience of the Vietnamese people during wartime. Guided tours provide insightful narratives, making it a must-visit for history enthusiasts.

For those looking to immerse themselves in nature, Gam Ghi Island is a captivating destination nearby. Known for its pristine beaches and crystal-clear waters, this island is perfect for a day of relaxation or adventure. Snorkeling and swimming in the vibrant coral reefs will leave you in awe of the underwater beauty. Additionally, An Thoi Port serves as a gateway to various island excursions, where you can discover hidden gems and enjoy the stunning coastal scenery. Don’t miss the chance to visit the tranquil Sung Duc Pagoda, a serene spot that offers a peaceful retreat and a glimpse into the local culture. Each of these attractions complements the comfortable stay at Cá Chép Hotel, making it an ideal base for your Phu Quoc adventure.

Convenient Access to Phu Quoc's Attractions from Cá Chép Hotel

Cá Chép Hotel is strategically located to offer guests seamless access to the stunning attractions of Phu Quoc Island, thanks in part to its proximity to key public transport stations. One of the most notable nearby transport options is the Hon Thom Cable Car, which is not only the longest cable car in the world but also a gateway to breathtaking views and thrilling experiences. Just a short distance from the hotel, this cable car provides an exhilarating ride over the turquoise waters and lush landscapes, transporting guests to the idyllic Hon Thom Island, where adventure awaits.

In addition to the Hon Thom Cable Car, the hotel is well-connected to various local transport services, making it easy for visitors to explore the island’s hidden gems. Whether you prefer taking a taxi, renting a scooter, or utilizing local buses, Cá Chép Hotel's location ensures that guests can effortlessly navigate to popular sites such as the pristine beaches, vibrant markets, and cultural landmarks. With such convenient transport options at your doorstep, your stay at Cá Chép Hotel promises to be both relaxing and full of exciting discoveries.

Culinary Delights Surrounding Cá Chép Hotel

Cá Chép Hotel is perfectly situated amidst a vibrant culinary scene that promises to satisfy every palate. Just a short stroll away, Nga Lam Seafood Restaurant beckons with its fresh catches and traditional Vietnamese flavors, making it a must-visit for seafood lovers. For those seeking a taste of Japan, Yushima Japanese Restaurant offers an exquisite array of sushi and sashimi, prepared with the utmost care. Kim Dao Restaurant invites guests to indulge in authentic Vietnamese cuisine, while Green Tree Buffet Seafood provides an all-you-can-eat experience, perfect for feasting on the island's freshest offerings. As the sun sets, PH Rooftop Bar & Lounge transforms into a chic spot for cocktails and stunning views, ideal for a romantic evening. If you’re in the mood for Korean flavors, Hi Say Korea Food And Tea Coffee serves up delicious dishes in a cozy atmosphere. Seafood enthusiasts will also love 136 Seafood Restaurant, known for its generous portions and vibrant flavors. For a taste of the Mekong Delta, Mien Tay offers a delightful menu that showcases local specialties. Don’t miss Quan Linh Duong for its warm ambiance and hearty dishes, or AT104, where you can enjoy a fusion of flavors that reflect the diverse culinary landscape of Phu Quoc Island. Each of these nearby restaurants enhances your stay at Cá Chép Hotel, providing a delectable journey through the rich flavors of Vietnam and beyond.

Affordable Comfort at Cá Chép Hotel: A Budget-Friendly Choice in Phu Quoc Island

Nestled in the serene landscapes of Phu Quoc Island, Cá Chép Hotel offers an inviting retreat at an impressive price point, with average room rates ranging from just $26 to $50. This makes it an attractive option for travelers seeking comfort without breaking the bank. The hotel’s affordable pricing allows guests to indulge in the beauty of the island while enjoying cozy accommodations that cater to their needs. Whether you’re a solo adventurer or a family on vacation, Cá Chép Hotel provides an exceptional value, ensuring that your stay is both enjoyable and economical.

In comparison, the average price for a hotel room across Phu Quoc Island hovers between $51 and $75. While many establishments in the area offer luxurious amenities and stunning views, Cá Chép Hotel stands out by providing a budget-friendly alternative without compromising on quality. Guests can experience the charm of Phu Quoc Island and its vibrant culture while staying at a hotel that prioritizes affordability and comfort. With such competitive pricing, Cá Chép Hotel is the perfect base for exploring the island's breathtaking beaches and lush landscapes.

Exceptional Experience at Cá Chép Hotel

Cá Chép Hotel in Phu Quoc Island stands out as a premier destination for travelers seeking both comfort and value. With an impressive overall rating of 8.9, guests consistently highlight the hotel’s exceptional value for money, scoring a remarkable 9.0 in this category. This dedication to providing an affordable yet luxurious experience makes Cá Chép Hotel a top choice for those looking to indulge without breaking the bank.

The facilities at Cá Chép Hotel are designed to enhance every guest's stay, reflected in a solid rating of 8.5. Visitors appreciate the modern amenities and well-maintained spaces that contribute to a relaxing atmosphere. Cleanliness is a top priority at the hotel, earning an outstanding score of 9.0, ensuring that every corner is spotless and inviting. Additionally, the hotel's prime location, rated at 9.1, offers easy access to the stunning beaches and vibrant local culture of Phu Quoc Island. Coupled with a commendable staff performance rating of 8.7, guests can expect warm hospitality and attentive service, making their stay truly memorable.
